newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Ladbroke raised at Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ladbroke raised at Lehman.

text.p: Ladbroke Plc was raised to "neutral" from "underperform" at Lehman Brothers, the investment bank said on Monday.

In a research note, aalyst Fraser Ramzan said recent results from the hotels-to-gaming group had showed positive surprises in hotel profit conversion and betting margins and that annualising such contributions suggested "further earnings upside."
Ramzan however warned that the company's balance sheet remained weak and said the shares were fairly valued at their current level.
The stock was up 2p at 225-1/2 by 0853 GMT.
